abstract_research_topics.value: neural dynamics and information theory in consciousness studies
abstract_research_topics.justification: This domain focuses on the theoretical underpinnings of consciousness, such as how neural dynamics and information theory contribute to our understanding of consciousness. It does not directly apply to practical applications but rather delves into theoretical and abstract concepts.

Though it has applications, the primary thrust of computational neuroscience is to advance theoretical models and simulations to better understand neural systems. This is an abstract theoretical domain focused on understanding the computational aspects of brain function.
Being explicitly labeled 'theoretical,' this domain focuses on creating models and theories to understand neural processes, making it a clear example of abstract research.
While cognitive neuroscience often informs applications, it is primarily dedicated to understanding the neural mechanisms underpinning cognition, positioning it within theoretical research domains.

Neuroscience broadly aims to understand the structure and function of the nervous system and its components. It is a foundational research area providing insights that may guide applications, but its core focus remains abstract.
As a plural term for diverse fields within neuroscience, the primary goal is theoretical understanding of nervous systems, from molecular to cognitive levels.
This domain focuses on the structure of the nervous system and understanding this morphology is essential for forming theories about its function, making it part of theoretical research.

Aimed at reviewing and ensuring the ethical deployment of AI systems in real-world scenarios, this is an application domain.
This domain involves addressing real-world ethical concerns and implications of AI technologies, thus falling under application domains.

This domain involves integrating ethical considerations into AI development and application, underscoring its relevance to practical applications.
